business_problem: Quantum needed to prepare FDA-compliant regulatory applications faster and more reliably because filing delays, rejection, or resubmission can postpone clinical trials and keep new therapies from reaching patients on time.
solution_summary: Quantum standardized regulatory publishing on DXC ToolBox Pharma Edition, a regulatory information management application that assembles FDA-compliant submission documents. Client content such as toxicology reports, manufacturing procedures, and clinical trial protocols is organized into FDA-approved templates so Quantum can produce Investigational New Drug and related regulatory packages with less manual effort. The latest deployment adds DXC FirstPoint RIM.AI, a cloud-native AI automation framework that accelerates document processing and filing workflows inside the platform. Together, the tools reduce processing time, expand capacity for new client work, and help pharmaceutical and biotech customers keep submissions on track so clinical trials and approvals are not delayed. The source does not name a separate storage layer, but it clearly positions ToolBox and RIM.AI as the governed production system for regulatory document automation.
